meta.description: Chatwoot webhook. Gates on human takeover, detects campaign, creates or updates the lead, answers from the knowledge base with gpt-4o-mini, posts the reply through Chatwoot, and optionally sends sample artwork.

parameters.query:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT id, service_key FROM campaigns
  WHERE active AND '{{ $json.normalized }}' ILIKE '%' || lower(match_text) || '%'
  ORDER BY length(match_text) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO leads (wa_id, chatwoot_contact_id, chatwoot_conv_id, campaign_id, ctwa_clid, ad_source_id, last_inbound_at, next_touch_at, drip_status, opted_out)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.wa_id }}',
  {{ $json.contact_sql }},
  {{ $json.conversation_id }},
  (SELECT id FROM matched),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.ctwa_clid }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.ad_source_id }}', ''),
  now(),
  now() + interval '3 days',
  CASE WHEN {{ $json.opt_out }} THEN 'opted_out' ELSE 'active' END,
  {{ $json.opt_out }}
)
ON CONFLICT (wa_id) DO UPDATE SET
  last_inbound_at = now(),
  chatwoot_conv_id = EXCLUDED.chatwoot_conv_id,
  chatwoot_contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.chatwoot_contact_id, leads.chatwoot_contact_id),
  opted_out = leads.opted_out OR {{ $json.opt_out }},
  drip_status = CASE
    WHEN leads.opted_out OR {{ $json.opt_out }} THEN 'opted_out'
    WHEN leads.drip_stage > 0 AND leads.drip_status = 'active' THEN 'replied'
    ELSE leads.drip_status END
RETURNING id, campaign_id, (SELECT service_key FROM campaigns c WHERE c.id = leads.campaign_id) AS service_key;

SELECT meta_media_id, media_type FROM media_assets
WHERE active AND meta_media_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (service_key = '{{ $json.serviceKey }}' OR service_key = 'general')
ORDER BY (service_key = '{{ $json.serviceKey }}') DESC, id
LIMIT 3;
